title: Area Under the Precision-Recall Curve (AUCPR)
description: Ability of a raw interface score to discriminate physiological from crystallographic (non-physiological) homodimer interfaces, measured as the area under the Precision-Recall curve. More sensitive than AUC-ROC to the class balance of the test set.
formal_definition: AUCPR = integral of Precision(r) over Recall r in [0,1], estimated by trapezoidal rule from the ranked raw score
